title: From heat gain to reaction enthalpy
hints: Heat transfers between reaction and surroundings.
Divide the sample heat in kJ by 0.0500 mol for the molar result.
solution: The reaction loses $[$h]$ J. Its molar enthalpy is $-([$h]/1000)/0.0500$ kJ/mol.

parts.statement:
The surroundings absorb $[$h]$ J when $0.0500$ mol of a reactant is consumed at constant pressure. Enter the sample’s reaction heat first.

[__________]{a}

feedback.message: The surroundings gain heat, so the reaction loses it.

parts.statement:
Now enter the molar reaction enthalpy in kJ/mol.

[________]{molar}

feedback.message: Divide the sample heat in kJ by the reacting amount in moles.
